findings.title: Record year for investment product sales in Hong Kong with robust demand for FICC-related products: SFC-HKMA joint survey 2025

rendered_html: 📔 Regulatory Bulletin — 9 September 2026 (Daily) Executive Summary • 🟡 The HKMA and SFC reported that 2025 non-exchange-traded investment-product sales reached HK$9.9 trillion, up 63% year on year, alongside higher client participation and online distribution. • The release is market intelligence rather than a new conduct or distribution requirement; it may inform commercial and risk prioritisation for investment-product businesses serving the surveyed customer segments. • FICC-related demand, including HK$698 billion of currency-linked product sales, and online sales reaching 21% of aggregate value may warrant targeted management information and customer-journey monitoring. Hong Kong 🟡 Record year for investment product sales in Hong Kong with robust demand for FICC-related products: SFC-HKMA joint survey 2025 🇭🇰 Item ID: item-20260908-hkma-press-d9180d4899 ⏰ Deadline: No source deadline stated Products: Investment products, FX-linked products, digital distribution The HKMA and SFC published their 2025 joint-survey results on 8 September, reporting HK$9.9 trillion of non-exchange-traded investment-product sales, up 63% year on year, across more than 1.6 million transacting clients and 452 selling firms. Collective investment schemes represented 42% of sales, structured products 40% and debt securities 9%; currency-linked product sales rose 50% to HK$698 billion. Online sales accounted for 21% of aggregate transaction value, compared with 17% in 2024, and 122 respondent firms distributed investment products online. This is official market intelligence, not a new requirement or supervisory action, but it may affect product-governance, distribution-risk and capacity prioritisation where a business serves the survey’s covered client segments. Source: Record year for investment product sales in Hong Kong with robust demand for FICC-related products: SFC-HKMA joint survey 2025 Mainland/GBA No qualifying current-run items. SG/UK/GLOBAL Benchmark Comparable overseas developments and commercial/control benchmarks. They do not establish Hong Kong requirements. No qualifying current-run items. Watch List • Monitor whether the reported FICC and online-distribution trends are reflected in relevant sales mix, customer journeys and management information; the release states no new deadline or requirement.
